title: Steady State Explanation
description: Essential Criteria: Clearly explain how the diameter D influences the physical process of gas exchange at steady state.

title: Mean Free Path Ratio
description: Essential Criteria: Provide the correct ratio of mean free paths l1/l2 for the case when D is much smaller than both l1 and l2.

title: Pressure Condition Ratio
description: Essential Criteria: Provide the correct ratio of mean free paths l1/l2 for the case when D is much larger than both l1 and l2.

title: Key Conditions Identified
description: Important Criteria: Identify the conditions under which the steady state occurs for both cases of D relative to l1 and l2.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Ensure that all physical quantities are expressed with appropriate units where applicable.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Avoid common errors such as incorrect assumptions about the relationship between D, l1, and l2.
